# transform all D4 and normalize
variants=[]
for refl in [False,True]:
 for k in range(4):
  p=set()
  for r,c in base:
   if refl:c=-c
   for _ in range(k): r,c=c,-r
   p.add((r,c))
  mr=min(x for x,y in p); mc=min(y for x,y in p)
  p=frozenset((x-mr,y-mc) for x,y in p)
  if p not in variants:variants.append(p)
found={}
for vi,p in enumerate(variants):
 h=max(r for r,c in p)+1;w=max(c for r,c in p)+1
 for r in range(len(a)-h+1):
  for c in range(len(a[0])-w+1):
   if all(a[r+x][c+y]==0 for x,y in p):
    found.setdefault((r,c,vi),p)
union=set()
for (r,c,v),p in found.items(): union|={(r+x,c+y) for x,y in p}
print('variants',len(variants),'matches',len(found))
for (r,c,v),p in found.items(): print(r,c,v)
for r,row in enumerate(a):
 print(' '.join('5' if (r,c) in union else str(x) for c,x in enumerate(row)))
